answer: Sponsor-liable invitations tie every new seat to an existing member who stakes on it. Each sponsor locks 400 POA per invitee, may vouch for at most 3 seats per epoch, and loses 100 POA whenever an invitee is proven a duplicate, say two seats filing word-identical reports on basalt weathering in one coastal dune field. A public atlas of invite edges shows who admitted whom, so a 300-seat farm needs 100 sponsor-epochs and 120,000 POA at risk. Fresh sponsors do not help, since a sponsor needs 6 epochs of its own passed work first.
